title: Module 2 Chapter 7 Spatial Databases training pack
sourceStatus: Entirely synthetic instructional data; not observations from the published Baltic coastal plant-traits dataset
coordinateStatus: Invented EPSG:3301 teaching geometries with no connection to real field sites
knownDeliberateConditions: One missing biomass value must remain NULL rather than become zero
One extreme biomass record is retained with review status
One plot has no second-round observation so join direction changes the population
One plot is exactly on a management-zone boundary so ST_Within and ST_Intersects differ
The handover inventory contains duplicate, mixed-CRS and missing-lineage conditions

assets.purpose: Training status, asset guide, deliberate conditions and safe-use boundary
Reviewable PostgreSQL/PostGIS teaching schema with integrity constraints and indexes
Synthetic parent table for site metadata and relational joins
Synthetic plot table with stable keys, coordinates, WKT and QA status
Synthetic repeated vegetation observations for filters, joins, NULL and aggregation practice
Synthetic polygon WKT for spatial predicates and boundary-semantics practice
Deliberately imperfect archive inventory for storage and governance decisions
Relational, spatial, performance, provenance and release evidence template
